description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Disputes, Notice of Repudiation of Award of an Arbitrator Dated 06/09/2023 Binding on J.H. Sisira Saman Kumara and Ceylon Fishery Harbour Corporation
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the repudiation of an arbitrator's award under the Industrial Disputes Act (Chapter 131). It involves legal procedures, statutory notices, and regulatory compliance requirements related to labor disputes, falling squarely within the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "legal notices and statutory declarations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While it mentions specific individuals and an organization, this is in the context of legal proceedings rather than government personnel appointments or structural changes.
